cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Lucy is a working offline coding assistant and autonomous dev agent: it plans, edits real files, runs commands, and verifies its own tool calls against a local codebase. It also connects to real software-engineering and knowledge-work tools (Penpot for design, AppFlowy for docs/PM, Cal.com for scheduling) via a genuine MCP client, so the software-engineering pairing is integral to what the submission does, not a narrative layer added after the fact.

test_prompts.prompt: This project has a data/ folder with several CSV files of student grades. Find all CSVs, compute the average score per file, write a summary report to REPORT_summary.md ranking the files by average score, and flag any file that has missing or malformed rows.

In this repo, the function calculate_discount in pricing.py has a bug where discounts over 50% are applied incorrectly for bulk orders. Find the bug, fix it, add a regression test in test_pricing.py covering the bulk plus high-discount case, and run the test suite to confirm it passes.
